title: Masterclass digital power and sovereignty
content: During this compact, intensive masterclass on Friday 11 September, internet pioneer Bert Hubert, Waag director Marleen Stikker and Open University professor Reijer Passchier will share their insights on digital power, public values and practical steps you can take to regain control of your data, processes and choices.

title: Buy it, use it, break it, fix it: exhibition opening
content: Join us in this festive opening of the exhibition "Buy it, use it, break it, fix it," where 6 works of artists and designers will be showcased.

title: What is a craftsperson 2.0?
content: What might a craftsperson in the future, or craftership 2.0, look like? Researcher Zoénie Deng describes the skills, mindset and knowledge needed for the modern craftsperson, using insights gained from the Tracks4Crafts project.

title: Community vouching makes vulnerable Amsterdammers visible
content: As part of the Trust-based Banking project, Waag Futurelab, in collaboration with Here to Support, investigated how community vouching can enable people to open a bank account.

title: Want more control over your data? Take the first step towards digital autonomy.
content: Waag Futurelab is organising three free workshops on digital autonomy, focused on data management, for civil society organisations in Amsterdam that work with sensitive data.
